text: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type AS target_type, td.tax_id AS tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type AS standard_type, a.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = ass.tid WHERE a.type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293267' AND td.tax_id = 9606 ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
